Signature Looks — Bridal Makeup & Styling, Chandigarh

Signature Looks is a Chandigarh bridal makeup and styling studio offering glam
Punjabi bridal looks, HD and airbrush options, and coordinated styling for the
bride and her family across multiple wedding events.

Their bridal package (two events) is ₹58,000, including a trial, hairstyling, and
draping. Family makeup is billed per person, and destination travel is extra.

Contact: +91 97800 90015 · book@signaturelooks.example
Location: Sector 9, Chandigarh
Rating: 4.6 / 5 (135 reviews)
